author: Jobs.com
title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote. https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm Role Overview: We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity. This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail. What You’ll Do: Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

author: Trabahero.PH
title: WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS
content: WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS! TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here! Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration? Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project! Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome! JOB DETAILS: Company: Turing. Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist. Location: Fully Remote. Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task; rate not specified). Project Duration: 10–12 weeks. Commitment: 20–40 hours/week. Start: After onboarding and portfolio approval. REQUIRED SKILLS: Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop, Digital Illustration & Sketching, Character Design & Cartooning, Composition, Color & Perspective, Creativity & Attention to Detail. HOW TO APPLY: trabaheroph@gmail.com Subject: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Attach your updated CV and art portfolio (Behance, ArtStation, Google Drive, or personal website). Shortlisted applicants will undergo portfolio review before onboarding.
